verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Cloud Backup feature exists (microsoft-authenticator-docs-9, -13) but provide no description of end-to-end encryption or a vendor-inaccessible key, and no encryption design documentation is cited anywhere. Community commentary even contrasts Microsoft's backup with an alternative app that explicitly offers 'encrypted backups' (microsoft-authenticator-comm-4), implying this property isn't established for Microsoft Authenticator.
